about: Roles of the registers of SYN1's points (split_regs_<tech>.csv), read from the RTL: forge at snax-forge 32dbcc6112eccb8a4943029a61a99220ec206f88 (its control RTL copied in src/), HLS from hls-exercises rtl/done/. Each entry: a pattern (Python regex, searched in the register's hierarchical path), its role, what the register holds, when it loads and what reads it, and where (an example register at W = 8, or the W where it exists).

forge.description: START, offset 0 (accelerator.json): the word last written to START. The start pulse comes from the write itself (address 0, bit 0), so this register only answers a read of START.

A read-write CSR (JOBS at offset 1, JOB_BEATS at offset 2 when the group has a fold): written over the CSR bus before START, given to ctrl as io_starts_*_bits_* when START is written, read back over the bus.
The CSR read buffer: loads every read's data, keeps it while rsp is not ready; drives csr_rsp_data_o when answerKept.
Set when a read's response was not taken (rsp valid, not ready); holds req.ready low and selects answer as the response.
COUNTER: cleared by an accepted START, +1 every busy cycle, held after the run; read only by the CSR bus (io_counter).
The group's busy bit: set by an accepted, non-empty START, cleared at the last result; gates every unit's firing; STATUS bit 0 and the busy pin.
STATUS's sticky done bit: set by the done pulse, cleared by the next accepted START; read only by the CSR bus.
The done pulse, registered: high the cycle after the run's last result (or after an empty START); drives the <group>_done_o pin.
A unit's T, the beats per result, latched from JOB_BEATS (io_start_bits_beats_0) at START; compared with the unit's beat digit _d to end each result.
The last unit's result count R, latched from JOBS (io_start_bits_jobs) at START; the run ends when its _given reaches it. For vecadd and vecmul (T = 1) it is the run's beat count.
The multiply unit's firing count, computed at START as JOBS x JOB_BEATS (its successor's R times T); the unit stops firing when mul_given reaches it.
A unit's results given so far (firings for a T = 1 unit): cleared at START, +1 on each result; compared with the unit's R.
A unit's beat digit: the beat within the current result, cleared at START and at each result's last beat; drives the datapath's `first` (restart the accumulation).
The serial sum's lane index (span > 1): cleared when the unit fires, +1 on each read; selects the lane SerialAccumulate adds next (io_units_*_lane).
A unit's pipeline valid slot (latency L slots, here 1): set when the unit fires and gives a result, held while frozen; the head is the unit's output valid.
A link buffer's occupancy between two units: + on the producer's give, - on the consumer's fire; stalls the producer when full and enables the consumer when not empty.
The accumulator of TreeAccumulate (vsum, dot 2, 3, 4) or SerialAccumulate (dot 5, 6): loads beat on `first`, else acc + beat, on fire; drives the result port.
One lane's running sum in the MAC lanes (dot 4, 5, 6): loads a x b on `first`, else s + a x b, on fire; read by the sum unit (directly or through the link buffer).
A LinkBuffer slot lane (dot 2, 6): holds the producer's beat (dot 2: the W products; dot 6: the W lane sums) from its give until the consumer reads it.

hls.description: A run-time pin latched at start (ap_vld): loaded when <pin>_ap_vld is high, the driver's one-cycle pulse with the accepted start; read by the loop's end test.
The pin's valid bit, kept: set by <pin>_ap_vld, cleared at ap_done; selects the latched value over the port.
Vitis's FSM state (one-hot): idle, the loop, done; drives ap_idle, ap_ready, ap_done.
A loop pipeline stage's enable: iter0 set while the loop runs, each later stage the earlier one's delayed; gates that stage's registers.
The start of a sub-module (DaCe's nested function or Vitis's loop module): set by the parent's FSM, cleared when the child is ready.
Vitis's loop-module done, kept until the next start: tells the parent the loop finished.
Vitis's loop-module first-iteration flag: set at start, cleared after the first iteration; selects the loop variable's initial value.
The beat counter b: 0 at start, +1 per beat; compared with loop_count to end the loop.
The beats in the sum in progress (cnt): +1 per beat, 0 when a result is written; compared with len.
The accumulator acc: acc + s per beat, 0 after each result; feeds the result written to out.
The registered last-beat test b + 1 == loop_count, carried to the stage that writes the result and ends the loop.
The registered end-of-sum test (cnt + 1 == len or the last beat), and its delayed copy: selects writing the result and clearing acc and cnt.
A lane operand: one lane of A_TDATA or B_TDATA (opt: straight from the port; unopt: shifted out of the registered beat), held for the next stage's add or multiply.
A lane operand in DaCe's loop module: one lane of A_TDATA or B_TDATA, held for the multiply.
An input beat or operand: A_TDATA (a) or B_TDATA (bb) registered as read (unopt W >= 2: the whole beat, unpacked lane by lane; opt W = 1: the single operand).
A lane result (vecadd: a + b) registered before it is written to C_TDATA.
The result a + b (W = 1), registered before it is written to C_TDATA.
A stage register of the lane tree: a lane product (mul) or a partial sum of lanes (add), and its delayed copy (_pp0_iter*_reg) where the stages are unbalanced.
W = 1: the product a x b from the multiplier, registered before acc + s.
W >= 2 (unopt): the beat's sum s, accumulated lane by lane (s + lane), 0 at each beat; added to acc after the last lane.
One lane's result (a + b or a x b) in the lane loop, registered before it is merged into the output beat.
One lane's product a x b in the lane loop, registered before s + product.
The output beat being assembled lane by lane (each lane's result shifted into place), written to C_TDATA after the last lane.
b + 1, registered: the beat counter's next value, loaded into b at the beat's end.
b + 1 or cnt + 1, registered: the beat counter's or the sum's beat count's next value, loaded at the beat's end.
The lane index l of the lane loop (l_reg) and l + 1 (l_1_reg): 0 at each beat, +1 per lane; ends the lane loop at W.
The lane's bit offset l x 64, registered (only bits [8:6] vary): shifts the lane out of the beat and into the output.
N = loop_count x W, the element count, computed and kept at start for DaCe's loop (its low log2 W bits constant 0).
DaCe's loop bound N - W + 1 (N - 1 at W = 2, N - 7 at W = 8), computed at start and compared with the element index i0.
loop_count truncated to 31 bits (DaCe's int N at W = 1), latched at start: a second copy of the pin beside loop_count_preg.
DaCe's element index i0: 0 at start, + W per beat (+1 at W = 1); compared with the loop bound.
A lane result a + b (dace::vec's operator+), registered before it is written to C_TDATA.
The result a + b (W = 1), registered before it is written to C_TDATA.
An operand (W = 1): A_TDATA or B_TDATA registered for the multiply.
The input element (W = 1): A_TDATA registered for the add.
DaCe's running sum: old_val + input per element; the result.
